bug_semantics: RechargePut in the CHF nchf-convergedcharging service treated a single path parameter as the underscore-joined pair {ueId}_{ratingGroup}, then did strings.Split(rechargingInfo, "_") and immediately indexed [1] with no length check. Any authenticated PUT whose path segment lacked an underscore — including a syntactically valid query-param call PUT /nchf-convergedcharging/v3/recharging/:ueId?ratingGroup=... against the old /recharging/:rechargingInfo route, where an IMSI such as imsi-208930000000003 is the entire path param — panicked with runtime error: index out of range [1] with length 1. Gin recovery turned the panic into HTTP 500, so the recharge path was remotely panic-triggerable for DoS/log flooding (CWE-129).
flaw_origin: The OOB split was first written in 50083ee6a9fb802b4585bf551dc3f04960d5a852 (Roy-Hu, 2023-03-27) as a feature change from recharge-by-ueId to recharge-by-rating-group. The parent handler only read c.Param("UeId") on route /recharging/:UeId and never split. The same unguarded four-line parse was later copied into internal/sbi/api_convergedcharging.go by the 2024 SBI rewrite (c963dcaced1f81d55e7802729f51298ec4693945), which is a move/copy, not the BIC.
